title: This International Fraud Awareness Week, We Can’t Forget The Role of Whistleblowers
content:
By Sophia Sabeh, TSN’s Legal Fellow

This week is International Fraud Awareness Week. Whistleblowers play a key role in exposing fraud, which includes actions that are meant to deceive for financial or personal gain.

The Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) reports that 43% of frauds were detected by “tips”; more than half of those tips came from employees and 14% came from anonymous sources. At the same time, whistleblowers do not always receive adequate protection and support: the ACFE reports that less than half of organizations surveyed globally train managers and supervisors on how to avoid, recognize, and respond to potential retaliation against whistleblowers.
